name: Hoglet Mother
text: Bristle 1. When this dies: summon a 1/1 Hoglet.
golden_text: Bristle 2. When this dies: summon a golden 2/2 Hoglet.

source.note: Bristle (N): whenever an enemy deals damage to this during an attack, deal N damage to that enemy after the exchange, before deaths are checked. Thorn damage never triggers thorns.
